results.title: Arsenal star Bukayo Saka has ice-cold four-word response when asked about Chelsea live on Sky Sports
results.description: ARSENAL star Bukayo Saka gave a cold response when asked about Chelsea ahead of their derby clash this weekend. The winger, 24, scored the only goal of the game to help Arsenal secure a 1-0 win at Aston Villa on Monday night. The Gunners now have back-to-back victories to start their title defence without conceding...
